title: analysis.opportunity.v1
description: Transport-ready as of the Kafka transport task (docs/adr/007-shared-cross-service-contracts.md; publisher: internal/transport/kafka/producer.go). Published by analysis-engine when a Strategy.Evaluate call produces a Candidate; consumed by algo-bot's target analysis_client package (docs/architecture/algo-bot.md, not built yet). Field shape mirrors analysis-engine/internal/opportunity.Candidate exactly (docs/architecture/analysis-engine.md) — this schema and that Go struct must be kept in sync by hand until a schema-to-struct generator exists (none does yet). Never contains a lot size, account balance, or risk multiplier — see docs/adr/002-analysis-vs-orchestration-boundary.md: an opportunity is a technical fact, not a trading decision. This is the PAYLOAD only — wrapped inside contracts/common/event-envelope-v1.schema.json's `payload` field; the envelope's own config_version/config_fingerprint carry "which configuration generated this," so algorithm_version below is scoped to the market-structure/liquidity algorithm identity specifically (source task §29's "algorithm version"), not configuration in general. No strategy is implemented yet (Analysis Engine V2 task) — this contract publishes no real events today; it exists ready for the first strategy task.

strategy.description: opportunity.StrategyID — an architectural slot name (e.g. "breakoutretest"), not yet a fixed enum since no strategy is implemented.

timeframe.description: Additive V1 field: closed-bar timeframe that first made the opportunity actionable. Retained pre-S11 events may omit it.

entry.description: opportunity.EntryZone — deliberately not internal/zone's richer Zone type; see docs/architecture/analysis-engine.md's naming note.

evidence.description: Machine-readable facts, per the source task's §25 — e.g. "major_structure_bearish", "m5_bos_down", "fvg_present". Never opaque free text.

quality.description: opportunity.StrategyQuality — strategy-specific components, per §26. Never a universal formula.

algorithm_version.description: Which versioned market-structure/liquidity algorithm produced the state this Candidate was derived from (engine.SnapshotVersion, source task §29's "algorithm version") — lets a replay/journal correlation ask "which exact algorithm generated this opportunity?" the same way config_version/config_fingerprint answer "which exact configuration."

formed_at.description: Unix seconds when the underlying technical primitive formed. Additive V1 field: current producers always emit it; consumers of retained pre-S11 V1 events must fall back to created_at when absent.

created_at.description: Unix seconds when the opportunity was first actionable and observed.

recovered_at.description: Additive V1 recovery fact: Unix seconds when the engine re-established ownership of a still-live opportunity after bootstrap. The technical observation remains created_at; consumers may use this only for an explicit current-live recovery path.

technical_context.description: Additive V1 field (S13B): engine-owned policy inputs for the closed bar that first made the opportunity actionable, so a consumer never recomputes ATR/structure from raw OHLC. Optional: when absent a consumer MUST treat policy inputs as unavailable and fail closed. Never carries a quote, spread, account or confluence-score value.

atr.description: Canonical ATR of `timeframe` as of the observed bar.

reference_price.description: Close of the observed bar; a geometric reference, not an executable price.

reference_time.description: Open time of the observed bar, Unix seconds.

bias.description: Confirmed structural bias (primary-timeframe derived). Omitted when the engine has none; never a guessed neutral.

higher_timeframes.description: Additive S12 field: independently confirmed, fresh H1/H4 reads from causal closed bars. `layer` is the decisive structure layer, or "momentum" when that frame's structure is undecided and the read falls back to the same frame's price momentum (a decided structure is never overridden). Empty/absent means policy must not infer an HTF bias from the entry timeframe.

confirmation.description: Additive V1 facts only on an independently identified, confirmed zone-reaction opportunity. Resting-zone opportunities omit this block and remain non-executable.

candle_evidence.description: Additive Candle Confirmation V2 evidence from the same closed observation bars. Descriptive only: consumers must not treat its score as an execution or risk decision.

stop_envelope.description: Additive Phase 4 field: engine-owned stop-distance risk policy for this candidate's own strategy family and target geometry (internal/engine's computeStopEnvelope, mirroring algo-bot's stop_bounds_for_reaction_room). Optional: absent means the consumer falls back to its own legacy per-strategy-family envelope lookup. desired_minimum_pips is a single-leg recommendation, not a final decision — a multi-leg group stop or a fixed-R:R instrument should use floor_pips as its minimum instead; that choice needs execution-time context (leg count, instrument targeting mode) this block deliberately does not carry.

source.description: Which family rule produced floor_pips/cap_pips — algo-bot's own stop_bounds_source telemetry values.
